title: Retail Storefront LED Display - RS Puram
short_description: Eye-catching outdoor LED display board for a retail store in RS Puram, designed to attract foot traffic with dynamic brightness and bold branding.
description: A retail store in the busy RS Puram commercial district needed a storefront board that would stand out among competing storefronts. We delivered a custom-sized outdoor LED display with high-brightness SMD LEDs, anti-glare coating, and a sleek aluminium frame finished in the brand's signature colours. The board features programmable content scheduling, allowing the store to display promotions during business hours and brand messaging after closing. The client reported a noticeable increase in walk-in customers within the first month of installation.

title: Corporate Reception LED Wall - Chennai
short_description: Sleek indoor LED reception display for a corporate office in Chennai, combining modern aesthetics with reliable daily performance.
description: A Chennai-based corporate office engaged us to create a premium reception area LED display that would serve as both a brand statement and an information hub. The installation features a seamless indoor LED panel with ultra-narrow bezels, custom-mounted into a wooden-panelled wall. The display runs a curated loop of company achievements, visitor welcome messages, and live updates. We also integrated a simple content management system that allows the reception staff to update messages in real time without technical assistance.

title: Government Hospital Wayfinding System
short_description: Large-scale indoor and outdoor wayfinding LED signage for a government hospital, improving patient navigation across multiple buildings.
description: A government hospital contracted us to solve a longstanding patient navigation problem across their sprawling multi-building campus. We conducted a thorough site audit, mapped patient flow patterns, and designed a tiered wayfinding system: outdoor directional monoliths at entry points, building identification signs, and indoor department-level LED directories. The boards use a colour-coded system with clear pictograms and Tamil-English bilingual text. The project was completed in phases to avoid disrupting hospital operations, and the feedback from both staff and patients has been overwhelmingly positive.

title: Clinic Chain Branded LED Signage
short_description: Brand-consistent LED signage rollout for a clinic chain across multiple locations in Tamil Nadu, ensuring uniform brand presence.
description: A fast-growing clinic chain needed consistent, high-quality LED signage across their new locations in Tamil Nadu. We developed a standardized design template that maintained brand consistency while adapting to each location's unique architectural context. Each installation included an outdoor pylon sign, a reception-backdrop LED board, and room-name displays for all consultation rooms. The project required coordination with multiple site teams across different cities, and we delivered all installations within the agreed timeline — a key factor in the client awarding us their ongoing signage contract.

title: Outdoor LED Billboard - Avinashi Road
short_description: Large-format outdoor LED billboard on Avinashi Road, engineered for 24/7 operation with weatherproof construction and remote brightness control.
description: For a brand looking to dominate the Avinashi Road corridor, we designed and installed a large-format outdoor LED billboard. The structure is engineered to withstand wind loads and monsoon rains, with IP65-rated LED modules and a corrosion-resistant steel frame. The display supports remote content upload and scheduling, allowing the client to rotate advertisements throughout the day and adjust brightness based on ambient light. The billboard has become a landmark installation on one of Coimbatore's busiest roads, delivering consistent visibility for the brand 24 hours a day.
